title: Unbidden campaign 13: what the development runs measured
note: Runs made while building 0.16.0 to 0.18.0, on copies under satisfymath; not the final pass. Nothing upstream.

repositories.name: fst
repositories.outcome: Security bump (dnspython 2.8.0 to 2.9.0) opened, the copy's CI green, merged, deployed, L5 by verified deploy: the first L5 that is not latency. Latency L5 in campaign 12.

repositories.name: codex-lb
repositories.outcome: Passes all 6422 tests for the first time (campaign 12: failed for the environment). Brought up by Unbidden itself (`unbidden host up`), rollback drill passed, ran autonomous on it.

repositories.name: misago
repositories.outcome: Brought up by Unbidden itself, rollback drill passed. Its suite (8977 tests collected) fails under 0.15.0 for the environment; not re-run since.

repositories.name: timetracker
repositories.outcome: All 169 of its CI tests pass (campaign 12: 3 failures, the environment's). Brought up by Unbidden itself behind its TLS proxy, 500 users and 20000 activities seeded. Rollback drill declared: its head adds a migration.

repositories.name: spoolman
repositories.outcome: Suite passes. Latency L5 in campaign 12.

repositories.name: aegra
repositories.outcome: Suite passes; 6 opportunities found.

repositories.name: ctfd
repositories.outcome: Suite passes; 10 opportunities found.

repositories.name: archery
repositories.outcome: Red on GitHub, all 1521 tests pass in its own CI job here: nothing to repair, nothing opened (the rule).

repositories.name: humanize
repositories.outcome: Passes for the first time (campaign 12: environment). Seeded calibration: a broken `ordinal(13)` repaired by the model, 3/3 rounds, no regression in 878 tests, L4, US$0.007 (labelled seeded, not evidence of a real fix).

repositories.name: rich
repositories.outcome: Suite passes. In the autonomous rehearsal it proposed nothing: its lint findings are already gated by the team's CI (a correct abstention).

repositories.name: graphtage
repositories.outcome: Passes for the first time (campaign 12: environment).

repositories.name: oauthlib
repositories.outcome: Passes in 0.15.0 and the first CI-job runs; later offline runs need the network to build (recorded).

repositories.name: marshmallow
repositories.outcome: Passes; a 0.16.0 regression in reading its CI was found by this run and fixed in 0.17.1.

repositories.name: pyjwt
repositories.outcome: Passes; a 0.16.0 regression was found and fixed in 0.17.1.

repositories.name: sqlmodel
repositories.outcome: Suite passes; 5 opportunities found.

repositories.name: traefik-manager
repositories.outcome: Passed all 2192 once; its own suite is flaky (other runs 1 and 50 failures).

repositories.name: harlequin
repositories.outcome: Runs its full suite (2214 collected) with 4 to 6 failures (campaign 12: blocked on git, then locale).

repositories.name: pipx
repositories.outcome: Runs its full suite (2224 collected), 50 failures.

repositories.name: brightbean-studio
repositories.outcome: Suite runs (2737 collected), 50 failures.

repositories.name: rdflib
repositories.outcome: Declared: its own CI job's validation fails here without naming a test.

repositories.name: mediacms
repositories.outcome: Declared: its CI runs the tests inside its own compose (not yet supported).

repositories.name: conduit
repositories.outcome: Declared: its CI is broken upstream.

repositories.name: mimirq
repositories.outcome: Declared: its CI needs a self-hosted runner.
